hansaazz: The quartermaster asked Walter "Tin" Hansaazz to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
tejci_mejci66: On Day 3 Leopold Mejci took a post at S-F6 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.

After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Leopold Mejci asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Leopold Mejci folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Leopold Mejci borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
